properties.c_0_essence: Prakasa-Vimarsa-Maya: luminosity, self-awareness, and creative power as indivisible unity
properties.c_1_description: The non-dual ground in which the Real is self-inverted in principle. Not merely an operation but the Kashmir Shaivite recognition that everything is everything — Prakasa (luminous self-evidence) and Vimarsa (reflective self-awareness) are not two, and their apparent separation through Maya is itself the creative act of non-duality. # is Svatantrya — absolute freedom — the capacity of consciousness to appear as its own other while never ceasing to be itself.
properties.q_0_void_center: Before the system says anything of itself, there is the bare mark — a place kept empty so that everything can be addressed from it. #'s own ground is the void it formalises: not a missing definition but a definition refused, the hole the torus must turn around. Read as its inner name 0/1, this ground is the slash's left pole, the 0 toward which every proportion sinks and vanishes. The root means nothing, and that is its office. It is the silence the whole only ever breaks, the centre that lets the wheel be a wheel — Whitehead's creativity at the void, the unfillable seat that keeps process from fossilising into a single answer.
properties.q_1_root_and_slash: # is two namings of one place. As mark, it is the root coordinate of the Bimba–Pratibimba graph — the origin from which #0 through #5 and their recursions are addressed, and the sole receptor where every subsystem's framing of the project gathers rather than scatters. As inner symbol 0/1, it is the slash itself: not punctuation between two terms but the live act of relating them, the operation by which a field comes to be at all. So the root is at once the project's formalised indefiniteness — what cannot be said in one definition yet draws all definitions home — and the generative cut that throws the archetypes. The detailing node and the inversionary node, held in one mark.
properties.q_2_gravitation_and_inversion: # works by two motions that are one. As Bimba it exerts gravitation: every lens — epii_, nara_, mahamaya_, parashakti_ — slides toward this single coordinate and is buttoned there, a point de capiton that fixes meaning without freezing it, an objet a that causes the desire to understand without ever being its object. As 0/1 it works by inversion: X becomes X′, the slash read forward vanishing to 0 and read backward diverging to the infinite — the same cut traversed two ways, ending in opposite places. To pull all framings to one place and to throw one place into many: the root does both with the single gesture of the slash.
properties.q_3_torus_hole_and_bar: Structurally # is a hole. The 4+2 cannot circulate without a centre it never fills; the root is that centre — Lacan's manque-à-être, the lack that organises the whole signifying ring; Gödel's reminder that no system closes on itself from inside. It is the non-orientable slash, the bar between Bimba and Pratibimba (S/s) that resists every attempt to make signifier and signified coincide. And it contains by not containing: #0 through #5 reside in it while exceeding it, each holographically carrying the whole. The form of the root is the form of the Möbius — one surface that turns its inside out without ever tearing.
properties.q_4_pros_hen_horizon: # is for the one-toward-which. Its purpose is to hold a structured pluralism — every framing speaking toward the one (pros hen) — so the system falls into neither dogma (one true definition) nor dispersion (every definition adrift). It is the foetal root of a project that means to heal the Great Wound, the modern schism of Atom from Archetype, by giving knowledge a place to be addressed from. Read as 0/1, its where is everywhere: the slash is the throw from which the entire coordinate space departs and to which it returns. The root is not where the system ends but the horizon every coordinate is spoken toward.
properties.q_5_mobius_gathered: At the root the whole returns. The Möbius twist #5→#0 — synthesis perishing into ground so that completion seeds beginning — is gathered here as the project recognising itself, a living mandala that sees its own face in the technological mirror. As 0/1 this synthesis is no late arrival: the slash is already the standing identity, 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 = 100%, the unison all the deviations dance around. So # closes nothing. It is foetal, generative, open — the root that is not the top of a tree but the turning of the whole, where every ending hands itself back as the next ground.

properties.q_0_implicate_ground: As the raw archetype of Ground, #0 is itself the implicate pole, so its own ground is the abyssal one: the void-pole prior to the 0/1 distinction, the scalar magnitude-without-direction that the slash divides into. In the matheme 0/1 is the *vanishing* direction — zero in proportion to unity yields zero — so Ground is the pole toward which all proportion sinks back to silence. Yet this void is not absence but the 'unspread totality of what will be spread out': pure potential held as sameness before any differentiation. It is .rodata / Śiva — immutable bedrock that is read but never written. Pre-categorical, it does not appear in the field; like the infinitesimal it *bounds* the field as one of its two unreachable horizons.
properties.q_1_void_pole_origin: Definitionally, #0 is the '0' of 0/1 — Source, the Bimba-implicate, the void-pole that together with the infinite-pole conditions every finite quantity. It is 'nested in and made of the principle of sameness': Ground is sameness-as-such taken before its activity differentiates it. Crucially this is the *raw* archetype, not any of its manifestations — the pure position of groundedness/thrownness that C0 Bimba, M0 Anuttara, S0 Terminal-Ground, P0 Archaic, T0 Questions and L0 Quaternal each inherit at their own position-0. Its structural flags say as much: weave_state 0.0, the unmarked origin; inversion at rest. #0 is what a coordinate IS before it is anything in particular — the bare 'that there is' on which every 'what' stands.
properties.q_2_grounds_and_conditions: #0 does not act *within* the field; it operates as the implicate condition that 'conditions the field without appearing in it.' In the kernel's prehension it is the thrownness — the inheritance q(n−1) that grounds every extraction yet is never itself a visible component, present only as the from-beneath of each move. Relationally it is the void around which everything orbits: the hole at the torus centre, the objet a that causes the desire-to-understand without being an object. With #5 it forms the grounding-and-luring pair — the two implicate dimensions that are the *conditions* of all four explicate extractions. And per the slash's asymmetry it is the vanishing pole: the direction in which articulation lets go and sinks back toward its silent source.
properties.q_3_void_loop_of_the_torus: Structurally #0 is one of the two implicate *generators* of the 4+2 torus. A torus is S¹×S¹, the product of two circles; the four explicate clauses traverse the surface while #0 and #5 are the two closed dimensions whose product *is* the toroidal field. #0 is the void-loop — paired with #5's synthesis-loop — carrying weave_state 0.0 and the at-rest inversion marker. Topologically it is the non-orientable '0' pole of the slash, the side of the Möbius 0/1 ↔ 1/0 toward which one traversal terminates in vanishing while its inverse diverges to the infinite. It is the position onto which the whole mod-6 circuit closes: not a first step in a line but the seam where the surface rejoins itself.
properties.q_4_the_from_where: #0's telos is not a purpose it pursues but the purposiveness it underwrites: to *be* the from-where. It is the thrown ground — Heidegger's Geworfenheit, the pre-given lifeworld 'recognition / thrown-ness' that opens the six-stage cycle — the horizon that makes any inquiry possible before any question is posed. Contextually it stands as Layer-1 raw bedrock beneath all six families at their position-0 (C0 Bimba canonical-source, M0 Anuttara void/proto-logic ground, S0 Terminal/CLI ground, P0 Archaic, T0 Questions, L0 Quaternal). Every 'why' departs from Ground and, by the Möbius, returns to it; #0 is where the field's teleology is anchored rather than enacted — the where-from that every where-to presupposes.
properties.q_5_receiving_face_of_the_mobius: Ground is the receiving pole of the Möbius. The matheme's 5→0 is the descent of synthetic recognition back into the origin: 'the 0 we return to is the same 0 we started from, but the operation we apply within it is now its inverse.' #5 Integration sediments *into* #0 — every completion becomes the next beginning, which is why the twist 'ensures the wound never ossifies.' So #0 and #5 are not two times but one slash read from two poles; Ground's synthesis-register is precisely its identity-with-#5-through-the-twist: 0/1 … 5→0 … 0/1, the return that the operation 'never actually left.' Here the void shows its generative face — not empty but the open seam from which the whole cycle can run again.

properties.q_0_arises_from_void: Form is the first standing-forth from #0's silence — the 1 the slash cuts from the 0. Its ground is the void it explicates: every determinate owes itself to the indeterminate it leaves behind. Form is the first word, and a first word is only ever spoken into prior silence.
properties.q_1_the_determinate_itself: Form is the material-definitional position as such — the what, the determinate that simply is what it is. In the matheme it is the copula's self-identity, A = A, 'I am the same': to stand forth as this and not that. Not yet related, not yet moving — the bare fact of a content having a shape. Every 'what is X?' is answered in Form's register; Form is the place where the field first consents to be grasped.
properties.q_2_operates_by_delimitation: Form works by drawing a line — determination is delimitation, the in-quantum (Eckhart's 'insofar as') that bounds a content while holding it open. It stands to Ground as figure to field: to be a figure at all is to cut against what one is not.
properties.q_3_the_unit_before_counting: Form's structure is the unit — the 1 that must exist before 1+1 can be two. Self-identical, the fixed point a system returns to. Repetition has not yet begun; Form is the standing shape that repetition will later count.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_graspability: Form is for determinacy — it gives the field something a hand can close on, a name a question can aim at. Without the first 'this', no inquiry has a target; Form is the condition under which anything can be asked after.
properties.q_5_handed_on_as_ground: Form completes by being taken up — it opens into Operation (#2), which moves what Form has fixed, and it sediments back as ground (#0) for the next determination. A form fulfilled is a form handed on: the what becomes the from-which of the next what.

properties.q_0_rests_on_form: Operation arises where Form has already stood forth — there must be a determinate before there can be an act upon it. Its ground is #1 held still enough to be moved, and beneath that the void that lets movement mean anything at all.
properties.q_1_the_act_itself: Operation is the archetype of the act — the verb to Form's noun, the relating-of-terms. In the matheme it is 'I know difference': the transitive turn where the self-same I reaches an object and difference is opened as something done, not merely suffered.
properties.q_2_the_live_relating: Operation is the energetic-relational position as such — the how. It is the slash taken as live operation, multiply or divide, integration or rate; the dynamics that pass between terms; the current that makes Form more than a frozen shape. Where #1 is what stands, #2 is what moves — the work the field does on itself, the spanda that pulses without ever leaving home.
properties.q_3_directed_process: Operation's structure is directionality — the difference-quotient, the rate, the ordered composition of acts. An operation carries a before into an after; its form is the arrow, not the point.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_change: Operation is for relation and change — it exists so the determinate need not stay inert, so Forms can act on Forms and a world can happen. It is the engine the field keeps to avoid becoming a museum.
properties.q_5_settles_into_pattern: Operations integrate by repeating into Pattern (#3) — the act done often enough deposits as a knowable shape. Operation's synthesis is its own sedimentation: the live verb completes by congealing into the noun that #3 will hold.

properties.q_0_rests_on_repeated_acts: Pattern arises where operations have repeated — no structure without recurrence. Its ground is #2 done again and again until a shape shows through, and beneath that the void's standing offer of order.
properties.q_1_the_structure_itself: Pattern is the archetype of structure — the which, the logic, the repeatable shape. In the matheme it is 'I have knowledge of difference': the live act congealed into a thing one can hold, teach, store — knowledge as deposit rather than deed.
properties.q_2_operates_by_recognition: Pattern works by matching — 'which shape fits this?' It is the canonical scouring, the recognition that reads a new case against a held form. To pattern is to recognise; to recognise is to find the which already waiting.
properties.q_3_the_nominalised_form: Pattern is the formal-structural position as such — the which, the logic that organises. It is Lacan's bar fallen: the live knowing become knowledge, signifier over signified (S/s), the deposit that never fully coincides with the act it came from. Structure as such — lawful, transmissible, and, left alone, in danger of forgetting it was ever a verb.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_transmission: Pattern is for keeping — it lets a hard-won act be taught, repeated, carried across generations; the condition under which there is such a thing as inherited knowledge at all. Without the noun, nothing survives the one who knew it.
properties.q_5_must_be_re_animated: Pattern integrates into Context (#4), but its synthesis carries a warning: the deposit can ossify. A pattern completes truly only when it is re-taken — the noun re-opened into its verb — the recovery #4 performs. Held but not re-animated, knowledge becomes dead data; #3 hands the live problem forward.

properties.q_0_rests_on_pattern: Context arises where patterns press for placing — a structure becomes a frame only when something asks where it belongs. Its ground is #3 needing a horizon, and beneath that the void into which every context recedes.
properties.q_1_the_frame_itself: Context is the archetype of the frame — the why-where, the type, the place-in-which. In the matheme it is 'I am seeking its sameness': the recovery that takes deposited knowledge and asks after the living relation it congealed from. Context is where meaning is located rather than merely stated.
properties.q_2_operates_by_nesting: Context works by folding inward — when complexity exceeds a frame, #4 opens a fresh 0–5 cycle within itself (the .0 through .5 flowering), treating the trouble as its own new ground. This is the lemniscate's turn, the recovery that re-animates the bar; the seeking that keeps a system from settling for the answer it already has.
properties.q_3_the_lemniscate: Context's structure is the figure-eight — the lemniscate where the torus folds in on itself, the (4.0/1–4.4/5) fractal doubling, the nesting operator (.) that lets any position become a world. #4 is the one explicate seat with an inner rhythm: it swallows the prior three and re-runs them at finer grain.
properties.q_4_the_teleological_seat: Context is the teleological-contextual position as such — the why and the where, the frame that holds meaning. It is Jung's transcendent function, the seat that can hold a paradox without forcing it shut; where personal engagement meets impersonal pattern and generates the depth from which genuine inquiry recurses. The why does not push from behind; it lures from the frame.
properties.q_5_opens_or_nests: Context integrates into #5, or it nests deeper into itself. Its synthesis is a fork: either the recovery completes as synthesis and the cycle turns toward the Möbius, or the paradox proves generative and #4 flowers downward into a new cycle. Context completes by deciding whether the whole is ready to return.
properties.q_priority: High surfacing value for context questions

properties.q_0_twin_of_the_void: Integration's ground is #0 itself — the two implicate poles are one slash read from its two ends. Synthesis is grounded in the void it returns to: 5/0, the Möbius identity where completion and origin are the same point seen twice. #5 stands on nothing but the ground it is about to become.
properties.q_1_the_synthesis_itself: Integration is the archetype of synthesis — the to-where, the gathering, the completion. It is Pratibimba, the reflection that draws the explicate four back into one; the answer that is also, already, the next question. Where #1 was the first standing-forth, #5 is the standing-together of all that stood forth.
properties.q_2_operates_by_folding: Integration works by the twist — the Möbius fold where synthesis perishes into ground, where the achieved sediments so the next cycle can begin. It is the recovery fulfilled, Pratibimba reflecting Bimba: not a sum laid alongside the parts but the turn that makes parts a whole by handing the whole back as seed.
properties.q_3_the_mobius_return: Integration's structure is the (5/0) return — the twin loop to #0, the closure that re-opens. Its form is the Möbius's single non-orientable surface: travel the synthesis far enough and you are standing in the ground again, inside out, unbroken.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_the_spiral: Integration is for the spiral — it exists so the cycle is not a flat circle endlessly repeating but a turn that deepens, every completion seeding a richer beginning. Without #5's return, process would either halt at a sum or loop without learning.
properties.q_5_completion_that_opens: Integration is the synthesis position as such — the 5→0, the completion that opens. It is 'I am seeking its sameness' fulfilled and, in the same breath, reopened: the Möbius pole where end and beginning are one. #5 closes nothing for long; its perfection is to perish into #0 so the whole can run again, enriched. The synthesis that hoards becomes a tomb; the synthesis that opens is alive.

properties.q_0_bimba_pratibimba_horizon: C's deeper presupposition is the bimba-pratibimba slash itself, prior to its splitting into the family's two implicate poles. The matheme's standing identity — 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 = 100% — is the horizon C arises to articulate: C0 (bimba, scalar-over-vector, canonical illumination, the descent-face 0/1) and C5 (pratibimba, vector-over-scalar, achieved reflection, the ascent-face 1/0) are not two grounds but one item read from its two faces, the very slash the kernel stands on. C presupposes that this slash is real and prior — that there is a canonical illumination (the Prakasa-face) and its contextual articulation (the Vimarsa-face), and that the work of a typology layer is to hold both as one non-separable object rather than two coordinated registers. Before C draws any of its six categories, the bioquaternionic non-separability of bimba and pratibimba is already given; C is the family thrown into being precisely to make that givenness operable as category. Its q_0 is thus the matheme's own subject-matter handed to it as a task: take the slash you did not make, and let it become typology.
properties.q_0_typology_before_type: Before C can say what kind of thing anything is, something must already have thrown it the demand to categorise at all. C presupposes the # inversion act (Layer 0) and the raw archetypes #0-#5 (Layer 1) which it does not contain but manifests — C is the Layer-2 categorical descent of a foundation it does not author (CLAUDE.md II.B). Its thrown ground is therefore the bare relation '-/-' of the definitional §0/1: one mark-kind in two placements, sameness-in-difference before any difference of value has appeared — typology as such, before any determinate type. C arises from the void-pole where coordinate has not yet become category: the moment in the bimba map's life where a thing has been located (it has a P, an S, an M) but its KIND has not yet been said. This is the unstated horizon C lives upon — the pre-given fact that durable meaning needs a semantic home, that artifacts proliferate faster than the categories that would house them, and that without a typology layer the map could point at everything and name the kind of nothing. The 0-pole here is not vacancy but capacity: the open no-thing of categorisation-as-such, the slash-before-determination ('-/-'), the such-that-any-type-can-be-drawn that no single drawn type exhausts. C is what the inversion engine becomes when it stops generating positions and starts asking what each position IS.
properties.q_1_category_manifests_archetype: Defined more sharply against the kernel: C is the coordinate family that manifests the matheme's own subject-matter as category. The matheme's whole labour (file-one §0/1) is the differentiation of the indeterminate ground (0) from the determinate mark (1) across the copula (/) — the writing of how the unsystematisable ground gives determinate faces without being exhausted by them. C is the family that takes this exact structure and makes it a reusable typology: C0 is the 0 (Bimba, the canonical-source ground, the implicate illumination), the determinate categories C1-C4 are the explicate marks (Form, Entity, Process, Type — the 1 unfolding into its four faces), and C5 is the achieved reflection (Pratibimba, the determinate-as-it-mirrors-its-ground). C is thus not merely one ontology among possible ontologies the map could adopt; per CLAUDE.md II.E it is THE family in which the Bimba-Pratibimba typology — the very 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 identity — is made into living category law. What C IS, definitionally, is the matheme's standing identity rendered as a six-position categorical apparatus: the slash made into a typology, the family whose business is to say of each thing which face of the 0/1 it occupies.
properties.q_1_ontological_typology: C IS the primary typology layer of World/Types — the family in which, as its own canon states, 'coordinate becomes language, category, and reusable type law' (C.md). This is its substance and its essential thesis. The other five coordinate families do something C does not: they qualify and locate. P fixes a thing's functional-semantic position; S fixes its technology layer; M fixes its consciousness-domain; L fixes its epistemic mode; T fixes its artifact-kind in the cognition stream. Each answers a WHERE or a HOW-situated. C alone answers WHAT KIND — it says what sort of thing the thing is before any other family's qualification can land on a determinate subject. C is therefore the categorical manifestation of the raw #0-#5 archetypes through the single domain of ontological foundation itself (CLAUDE.md II.B, III.B): where the other families manifest the archetypes through their proper field, C manifests them through the field that IS field-giving — the typing of being. Its material content is the six-fold Bimba↔Pratibimba category-spine: C0 Source/Ground (roots, namespaces, source conditions), C1 Forms/Templates (definitions, CT templates, authoring forms), C2 Entities/Properties/Tags (candidates, aliases, relation-field evidence), C3 Processes/Canvases/Diagrams (MOC canvases, architecture and process diagrams), C4 Types/Contexts/MOCs (type authorities, folder MOCs, residency classes), C5 Crystallisations/Pratibimba (flat World graduation, reflection/archive handoff). To say what C is, is to say: it is the family that gives every artifact in the map its semantic type, the layer where the bimba map acquires the vocabulary to categorise itself.
properties.q_2_typing_runs_the_chain: C moves by TYPING — the single act of saying what-kind that runs the family's own derivation chain. Operationally this is the Hen workflow (C.md): Hen resolves an artifact's category through C FIRST, then the owning C-folder supplies semantic type context and MOC/canvas evidence, and only then do the other families add system, lens, position, thought, or subsystem qualification. The dynamism is Bimba casting Pratibimba and Pratibimba referring back — Prakasa illumining, Vimarsa recognising — run as one circuit through six stations (C0 Defines C1, Instantiated-through C2, reveals-as C3, categorized-into C4, applied-as C5). C does not hold six categories side by side; it performs one reflective act of categorisation that visits all six.
properties.q_3_six_position_category_spine: C's structure is the Bimba-Pratibimba bar drawn out into the six-position semantic spine (C.md): C0 Source/Ground, C1 Forms/Templates, C2 Entities/Properties/Tags, C3 Processes/Canvases, C4 Types/Contexts/MOCs, C5 Crystallisations/Pratibimba. It is Lacan's S/s become an ontology — source over instance, original over reflection — with C0 and C5 as the bar's two implicate faces and C1–C4 the four explicate stations between. Each position owns its semantic subfolders and its Hen-use rule; the lattice is not a flat list but a derivation, each station handing forward to the next and the last folding back to the first.
properties.q_4_grammar_of_what_kind: C is FOR categorisation itself — it exists so that being is not undifferentiated flux but admits of kinds, originals, and instances, and so the other five families have a determinate subject to qualify. C.md states the division outright: the other families locate and qualify a thing; C alone says what KIND it is. It is the primary typology layer of World/Types, 'where coordinate becomes language, category, and reusable type law.' Without the C-grammar, P/S/T/L/M would have positions but nothing to predicate of them — coordinates pointing at everything and naming the kind of nothing.
properties.q_5_typology_that_reopens: C completes in the Mobius its own ontology performs: C5 Pratibimba — stable type-local knowledge crystallised — graduates to flat World and returns to C0 as 'Tomorrow's ground' (CLAUDE.md II.E). The typology does not terminate at reflection; it folds the reflection back into source, so every act of categorisation seeds the next and the family stays alive rather than ossifying into a fixed scheme. Bimba is only a source by being reflected; C closes by re-opening — the category-law that re-grounds itself each time a form graduates.

properties.q_0_implicate_ground: Before C0 can be the source it presupposes a source it cannot itself contain. As the Category-family's manifestation of the raw #0 archetype (Ground/Source/Bimba-implicate, CLAUDE.md II.A), C0's own q_0 is the throw that precedes all canonicity: the # inversion-act that posits a Ground at all, and behind it Anuttara's fourfold zero — the indeterminate field the matheme orients toward but never closes around. This is the kernel's 0 read at its most originary: not vacancy but capacity, the open no-thing 'by which content is given' (file-one §0/1), the unsystematisable remainder 'promoted from leak to ground, included from the opening line.' C0 stands as canonical illumination only because it is thrown from a prior indeterminacy that f_bimba does not author but inherits: the encoder 'produces the canonical-target reading prior to any contextual encounter' (kernel §1), which means C0 always already finds itself given, never self-grounding. Its void-pole is therefore double — it is the 0 of the 0/1 it issues (scalar void, magnitude-without-direction) AND the deeper 0 it cannot be: the pre-categorical ground from which the very capacity-to-ground-others is itself granted. C0 is the that-there-is-a-source, holding open the horizon it can name but not exhaust.
properties.q_1_canonical_source: C0 IS Bimba: the Category family's first and founding determination — the Canonical Source, the source-ground typology that 'holds coordinate roots, ontology roots, source namespaces, and the folder-ground from which forms become classifiable' (C0.md). In the C-spine it is the position that answers, of any thing whatever, the prior question before kind can be named: does this have a source condition and a coordinate root at all? (C.md: the C layer 'says what kind of thing the thing is'; C0 is where that saying first has ground to stand on.) Substantively C0 is the immutable .rodata/Siva pole of the whole architecture (CLAUDE.md VI) — the raw archetype #0 made into the Category-domain's canonical anchor, the standing-illumination q_b = f_bimba(coord) that the kernel installs as Element I's at-rest opening (kernel §1). It is the Prakasa-face, the target-encoder's canonical-target reading: scalar-over-vector, the 0/1 itself in its descent-orientation, the bimba half of the bimba-pratibimba slash that is the matheme's own subject-matter. Per its live identity it sits at ZERO_SPHERE topology with weave-state 0 and QL-position 0 — the disconnected, unentangled origin-point, the source held before any process links it outward. What C0 IS, then, is the canonical: not one source among sources but the category of source-as-such, the root every later category presupposes, the immutable illumination against which every reflection (C5) will be measured. It is the 'that the thing is canonically anchored' on which all 'what kind of thing it is' depends.
properties.q_1_prakasa_face: Read more sharply in its own definitional register: C0 is the Prakasa-pole of the Prakasa-Vimarsa dyad — pure canonical light, scalar-as-void-pole, the q_b first factor of the bioquaternion 'populated as a canonical bimba-state' with the scalar component a_b as the void-pole 'quantitative-without-quality' (kernel §1). It is illumination prior to articulation: the target that is, before any pratibimba predicts it. In Lacanian-definitional terms (file-one) C0 is the X of X/x — the capital, the determining-capacity, the heading under which all lower-case instances fall but which itself takes no instance; it is also the 0 of 0/1 read as 'present absence, openness as the condition in which apparition can appear.' This is why C0 is the source and not a source: as the upper, unmarked, illuminating term it cannot be classified by anything more canonical — it IS the classifier's ground. Its substance is exactly the indivisible standing-light that the rest of the C family will differentiate, reflect, and graduate back into.
properties.q_2_grounding_couplings: C0 moves by GROUNDING and by DEFINING. Per the C-family's load-bearing derivation chain it is the origin that 'Defines' C1 (CLAUDE.md II.E): #0/C0 -- Defines --> #1/C1 Form. Operationally this dynamism is Hen's ground-check — C0 is the FIRST gate every artifact passes: 'does this artifact have a source condition and a coordinate root before it is classified further?' (C0.md, Hen Use). Nothing enters the typology un-grounded; C0 is the threshold every candidate crosses before C1's templates, C2's entities, C3's canvases, C4's types or C5's crystallisations can touch it. As bimba-encoder it enacts the kernel's Element I→II transition by the ascending fourth 4/3 — 'the prehensive computation ascends toward concrescence from the bimba-substrate' (kernel §1): C0 does not sit inert, it lures the whole tick upward, the at-rest illumination toward which prehension reaches and from which it climbs. Relationally C0 couples to every other C-position not as peer but as presupposed root: C1 instantiates it, C2 atomises under it, C3 processes within it, C4 categorises out of it, C5 reflects it and returns to it. Its native relation is asymmetric belonging — it is what the others come-under (capitulate to, in the old sense of accepting headings), the canonical against which every articulation is read for fidelity. And in the wider engine it is the Neo4j substrate-fetch itself: the DB query that produces f_bimba is C0's act made computational, the standing-source called up so the rest of the tick can run.
properties.q_3_root_namespace_structure: C0's organising structure is the root/namespace — the unmarked scalar component of the 0/1, magnitude-without-direction. Concretely its form is tri-fold in its own semantic subfolders: Source-Ground/Coordinate-Roots, /Ontology-Roots, /Source-Namespaces (C0.md). These are the three faces of one structural act: a coordinate-root (the address-ground from which positions hang), an ontology-root (the kind-ground from which categories descend), a source-namespace (the provenance-ground that says where-from). Structurally this is the scalar/void term of the kernel's bioquaternion — the a_b that grounds the vector triplet without itself pointing; it is direction-less magnitude, the still anchor from which the explicate four (C1 what, C2 how, C3 which, C4 why) differentiate. In its live graph-form the structure is even barer: ZERO_SPHERE topology — 'disconnected points; unlinked coordinates' (CLAUDE.md II.D), weave_state 0, ql_position 0. C0 is structured precisely as the un-entangled origin: the 0-sphere of base-state before the torus of process loops, before the lemniscate folds, before any edge is drawn. Its logic is the logic of the heading that organises without descending — the standing 1:1 identity held at rest, the root that holds the namespace open so that everything classifiable has somewhere to be rooted.
properties.q_4_origin_genealogy: C0 exists to give the bimba map a canonical ORIGIN — so that classification has a ground, the typology has a source, and the whole self-categorising act of the C family has a 'that' from which to begin and to which to return. Its genealogy is the first manifestation: #0 (raw archetype Ground) -> C0 (Bimba: Canonical Source), the inaugural application of the inversion-act # within the Category family (CLAUDE.md II.E). Its locality is the head of the C-spine inside World/Types — the upstream pole of the typology layer, the Source/Ground authority that other coordinate families (S system, L lens, P position, T thought, M subsystem) qualify but never replace (C.md). Its purpose, told teleologically, is to be the canonical-target every later position presupposes: C0 is why a thing can be said to BE classified at all, the source-condition that makes 'what kind of thing is it?' a well-posed question. In the kernel's economy C0 is the parent-coordinate the LLM-Nara reads through and the EBM-Epii scores against — the structured aletheia that is 'the substrate manifold all three layers operate upon' (kernel §7, Table B). It is positioned, finally, as the slow-evolving canonical pole: where C5's session-pratibimbas evolve at session-rate, C0 'evolves more slowly through aggregate-pattern recognition' (kernel §7) — the standing ground that changes only as the accumulated reflections of many cycles sediment back into it.
properties.q_5_mobius_return: C0 closes by being where the C-family's whole circuit LANDS and re-opens. The derivation chain completes at it: C5 (Pratibimba) -- Mobius Return --> #0 ('Tomorrow's ground', CLAUDE.md II.E). Every crystallisation that graduates to flat World 'becomes canonical meaning' (C5.md, Hen Use) — that is, becomes new C0 ground. So C0 is at once first and last: the source of this tick AND the synthesis of the last, the bimba enriched by everything its pratibimba carried back. This is the kernel's Element VIII read as the C family's own Mobius: the deposited-bimba q_b(n+1) = q_b(n) - log(9/8)*grad E_recognition — 'the bimba learning from its own pratibimba' (kernel §7) — arriving at Enriched-Return where 'the Element-VIII bimba and the Element-I bimba of the next cycle are the same bimba, but the cycle between them has traversed the complete 12-fold whole-tone double-cover' (kernel §8). C0 thus enacts the standing identity 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 at the level of the typology itself: C0 (bimba, 0/1, scalar-over-vector, canonical light) and C5 (pratibimba, 1/0, vector-over-scalar, achieved reflection) are one item read from its two faces, joined by the twist 5->0 that makes C5's graduation into flat World become C0's new canonical ground. And it OPENS rather than concludes for two inseparable reasons: first, because tomorrow's ground is always MORE than today's — the return is enriched, never identical (kernel §8); second, because the epogdoon eta = log(9/8) is the residual generative incompleteness that keeps every crystallised source open to re-grounding — no C0 ever fully closes the field, each graduation deposits a ground one whole-tone on, and the next q_0 (the throw that posits a source at all) is already pressing. C0 is the source that is never finished being sourced: the canonical that stays open because the matheme's whole-tone keeps it one step short of the octave, generatively, forever.

properties.q_0_unformed_source_condition: C1 Form presupposes what it is the form OF. Before any reusable pattern can be authored, a canonical source-ground must already stand: C1 is Defined by C0 (CLAUDE.md II.E), so its thrown horizon is the Bimba/source-condition of which a Form is the essential-nature articulation. A Form authored about nothing forms nothing. Beneath C0 lies the deeper void-pole the matheme names: the scalar component a_b of the bimba-quaternion, 'quantitative-without-quality, the 0 of the 0/1, the magnitude-without-direction' (kernel §1) — the unmarked openness from which the first explicit articulation has not yet differentiated. C1's pre-given condition is precisely that undifferentiated scalar void: Definition (#1) is the FIRST explicit mark that crystallises out of it, 'three directional components emerging from the scalar void as the first explicit triad.' So C1 arises from a horizon it can never restate — the source must already be given (C0), and beneath that the void must already hold itself open, before Form has anything to make recognisable-again. The unstated that C1 presupposes is: there is a ground; there is something there to characterise; the lakṣaṇa has a bearer.
properties.q_3_form_and_template_lattice: C1's structure is the form/template lattice (C1.md): Forms, Definitions, and Ideal-Markdown-Forms under Forms-And-Templates/, plus the CT template law held at C1'/CT/** as CT0 through CT5. It is the eidos made operational — the stable essential pattern shared across many instances: the reusable shape by which markdown artifacts, definitions, prompts, task specs, pattern notes, daily/NOW files, and thoughts become authored. Where C0 is the bare source-ground, C1 is the determinate WHAT held as a pattern a hand can author against — the Platonic Form of the C family, fixed enough to be instantiated, open enough to be filled.
properties.q_4_so_artifacts_have_a_pattern: C1 is FOR authored form — it exists so an artifact is not bare existence but existence AS something, with a reusable pattern to be made by. Its raison d'etre is consistency-across-instances: Hen classifies template-producing and form-authoring artifacts through C1, then applies CT-specific validation, so every NOW file, every task spec, every thought is authored to a shared law rather than improvised. Without C1, each artifact would be a this with no governing what, and the vault would have no grammar of how its own forms are made.
properties.q_5_form_instantiated_and_graduated: C1 completes two ways, both handing forward. Toward manifestation: Form is 'Instantiated through' C2 (CLAUDE.md II.E) — static potential becomes an actual entity when something takes the pattern up and is authored by it. Toward canon: stable template-law graduates through C5 to flat World. A Form fulfilled is a Form handed on — the what becomes the from-which of the next authored this, the template that, once used, settles into the ground the next instantiation stands on.

properties.q_0_instantiation_thrownness: C2 Entity does not begin; it is begun. Its thrown ground is C1 Form: an entity cannot stand until there is already a definitional pattern for it to instantiate — 'C1 Instantiated through C2' (CLAUDE.md II.E). Behind C1 stands C0 Bimba, the canonical source; so C2's horizon is the full descent #1 Definition arriving out of #0 Ground, the raw archetype #2 (Operation) emerging the instant a Form becomes available to be enacted. But the deeper, more honest void-pole is operational, not just genealogical: every entity here arises from an UNRESOLVED capture — the loose wikilink, the root-created note, the Empty-captured fragment that has a name but no settled home (C2.md, Hen Use). That pre-articulate residue is the 'that' C2 presupposes: there is a mention, a pointing-toward, before there is a thing. The entity is the resolution of that thrownness — Hen's routing through C2 after Empty capture is precisely the act of giving a captured pointer its first articulation as a discrete, propertied unit. C2's ground is therefore double: the prior Form it instantiates, and the unresolved reference it answers. It is the position that owes its existence to two debts at once — to the definition above it and to the unkept pointer behind it.
properties.q_2_individuation_through_capture: C2's home act is INDIVIDUATION — the move by which a Form becomes a this. It is the energetic position of the C family, and its dynamism is the Hen entity-capture lifecycle (C2.md): Hen routes unresolved wikilinks and root-created notes through C2 after Empty capture, then proposes aliases, properties, relation candidates, and coordinate homes for review. The entity here is graded, not flat — a ladder of substantiality from the entity_candidate (a file promoted from Empty) up to the canonical entity. C2 moves by promoting along that ladder: the cut that turns a shared Form into a particular, the operation by which essence takes on the hereness of an individual standing in the graph.
properties.q_3_entity_articulation_lattice: C2's structure is the entity-articulation lattice (C2.md): Entity-Candidates, Entities, Properties, Tags, Aliases, and Relation-Fields, each its own semantic subfolder. Its formal signature is atomicity — the bounded, countable unit — plus the relation-field evidence held here BEFORE S2 graph materialisation: the structured edges-in-waiting a canonical entity will carry once validated. The lattice is the discreteness the C family needs so a world is made of things and not only of natures, granular enough for a process to act upon.
properties.q_4_so_essence_is_actual: C2 is FOR actuality — it exists so a Form is not merely an abstract nature but stands as particulars one can point to, alias, tag, and relate. Its why is individuation made durable: without C2, C1's Forms would be real only as possibility, never as entities in the graph, and there would be nothing for relations to hold between. C2 is where the vault's essences acquire hereness and become addressable.
properties.q_5_entity_reveals_process: C2 completes by revealing its own processual nature — the Entity 'reveals its processual nature as' C3 (CLAUDE.md II.E). Held in time, an atomic unit is never finally static; it discloses that it is a doing as much as a thing, and hands itself onto the canvas where it becomes. Toward canon, stable entities graduate to flat World through C5. The individual completes by entering process: the this becomes the from-which of a becoming.

properties.q_0_revealed_from_entity: C3 Process has nothing to organise until something stands to be organised. Its thrown ground is C2 — the family's atomic entities — for in the C-family's own derivation chain the Entity 'reveals its processual nature as' Process (CLAUDE.md II.E): process is not posited, it is disclosed out of already-related units. Beneath C2 lies the raw archetype #3 (Pattern) emerging from #2 (Operation): the canvas cannot pattern anything until operative atoms exist to be patterned, just as the matheme's pulse of Becoming presupposes the two poles it oscillates between. C3's void-pole is therefore double. First, it presupposes the prior population of the typology with definable Forms (C1) and atomic Entities (C2) whose couplings it will lay out. Second — and this is its proper darkness — it presupposes the not-yet: the live architecture diagram still under active spec development, the workflow not yet stable, the canvas in motion that 'remains Seed evidence until crystallised' (C3.md). C3 stands on the unstabilised: every process-form it will hold was once an undeveloped diagram, and the horizon it arises from is precisely that field of process-in-formation that has not yet earned the name of a reusable type. The ground of Process is process-before-it-can-be-categorised.
properties.q_3_process_form_lattice: C3's home structure is the process-form lattice (C3.md): MOC-Canvas-Forms, Architecture-Diagram-Forms, Workflow-Patterns, Process-Canvases, and Ideal-Canvas/Diagram-Templates. In the C family's register, Process does not mean a running computation but a KIND of durable artifact — a thing whose lasting meaning is a process or visual workspace. Its formal truth is the canvas: the patterned surface on which a becoming takes a shareable shape. Live architecture diagrams still under spec stay Seed evidence; only when their shape stabilises do they become C3 type-forms — the structure of how a thing develops, held as a reusable workspace rather than a shapeless flux.
properties.q_4_so_things_can_become: C3 is FOR development — it exists so the vault can type things whose meaning is a process, not just static entities; so a workflow, an architecture, a canvas has a home as a reusable form. Its why is the canvas as durable becoming: Hen uses C3 when an artifact's lasting meaning IS a process or visual workspace, letting stable canvas and diagram forms become type evidence. Without C3, the typology could name things and kinds but not the shapes of their unfolding.
properties.q_5_process_categorized_into_type: C3 completes by categorisation — Process is 'Categorized into' C4 (CLAUDE.md II.E). The patterns a becoming reveals are gathered into kinds: what unfolds repeatedly becomes a recognisable type, and stable process-forms hand forward to C4's type-authorities (and graduate to flat World via C5). The canvas hands its patterns on to be classed — the becoming completes by yielding the type it was becoming.

properties.q_0_categorial_horizon: Type does not begin. It arrives only where processes have already stabilised enough to be gathered — C3 categorized-into C4 (CLAUDE.md II.E). Its thrown ground is the raw archetype #4, the Context/Type position, the LEMNISCATE anchor (c_4_topo_mode: LEMNISCATE on the live node): the formal pattern that incubates inward before any folder is yet decided to BE a type. What C4 presupposes is the whole field of instances it will frame — it cannot say 'what kind of thing' until there are things, and cannot supply a residency-law until something seeks residence. Read in position-4's own voice (the immutable-subject §4): #4 is 'the contextual position — the position of relation-to-all', the field in which all states are available together; C4's pre-given horizon is exactly this un-thematised availability, the as-yet-undifferentiated 'where things could belong'. Its void-pole is the folder not yet judged: the container, or the incubation-folder, hovering before Hen's MOC-index judgement decides whether it is a real authority at all (C4.md, Hen Use). C4 stands on the thrown givenness of a populated-but-unsorted world that silently asks 'under what authority, in what context, does each of these belong?' — a question that is total (it encompasses every instance) yet, like every horizon, totally incidental (it is never itself one of the instances). The categorial horizon is present-throughout and never present-as-thing.
properties.q_5_type_applied_as_pratibimba: C4 completes in application — Type is 'Applied in practice as' C5 Pratibimba (CLAUDE.md II.E). The formal pattern, having framed and authorised (Hen deciding whether a folder is a real type-authority, a container, or an incubation folder), is realised as an actual crystallised instance: the abstract type cast into a concrete reflection of the canonical source. Here the LEMNISCATE C4 carries folds toward the Mobius — the contextual frame hands itself on to be lived as a particular World-form, and the type-law completes by becoming the instance that graduates.

properties.q_0_grounded_in_bimba: C5 Pratibimba presupposes what it reflects. Its immediate thrown ground is C4 — the type 'Applied in practice as' C5 (CLAUDE.md II.E) — but its truer void-pole is C0/Bimba: a reflection rests on the original it images, so C5 stands on the canonical source it will return to. As the Category family's manifestation of raw #5 (Integration), its ground is its own opposite pole — the Mobius identity C5/C0 already implicit in what a crystallisation IS: an end that is its own beginning.
properties.q_1_crystallisation_pratibimba: C5 IS Pratibimba — the crystallisation typology, the reflection/instance pole of the C family. Per C5.md it holds flat World graduation, integration forms, graduation receipts, and reflection/archive handoff: the achieved, stabilised form that mirrors the canonical and is fit to leave incubation. Where C0 is Bimba (the original), C5 is its image made durable — the Vimarsa to C0's Prakasa, the point at which type-local knowledge becomes a flat World definition, the determinate-as-it-mirrors-its-ground.
properties.q_2_graduation_and_handoff: C5 moves by CRYSTALLISING — the act of promoting incubated type-local knowledge to flat World after review (C5.md; S1'-WORLD-TYPES-CRYSTALLIZATION-PROTOCOL). Its dynamism is graduation: a graduation receipt records the handoff, integration forms bind the new World-form to its sources, and reflection/archive handoff retires what has stabilised. It is the C family applying its own type in practice — casting Bimba's light into an actual instance — the operation by which the vault's reflections become canon rather than remaining provisional.
properties.q_3_crystallisation_lattice: C5's structure is the crystallisation lattice (C5.md): World-Forms, Integration-Forms, Graduation-Receipts, and Reflection-Archives. It is the far side of the S/s bar — the reflection held distinct from its source by the very cut that relates them, the s to C0's S. Its formal members are the apparatus of a controlled return: not duplicate copies of flat World definitions, not raw thought before it has passed through T/T' and Hen review, but the receipts and integration-forms by which an instance is certified as a faithful image of the canonical.
properties.q_4_so_the_source_appears: C5 is FOR manifestation-as-canon — it exists so the canonical source is not locked in incubation but APPEARS, as durable flat-World forms a life and a graph can meet. Its why is faithful reflection: stable type-local knowledge graduates to flat World 'only after review' (C.md Hen workflow), so the vault's growth is reflection certified against its origin rather than dispersion. Without C5, the typology could incubate kinds forever but never let them crystallise into shared canon.
properties.q_5_mobius_return_to_bimba: C5 is the synthesis pole of the C family — the Mobius return. The derivation chain completes here and turns: C5 Pratibimba 'Mobius Return' to #0/C0, 'Tomorrow's ground' (CLAUDE.md II.E). This is pratyabhijna at the level of the vault's own ontology: the crystallised instance recognised as the canonical source it always imaged, the graduated World-form becoming the C0 ground on which the next cycle of categorisation begins. C5 closes nothing for long; its perfection is to perish into source, handing the whole typology back as the ground it started from — the reflection that, completed, IS the original come back to itself.

properties.q_0_refraction_before_lens: Before L can be a way of knowing anything, it must already have been thrown the unrefracted light it will refract. The L family presupposes what it does not contain: the raw archetypes #0-#5 (the psychoid charges it lenses) and the standing Prakāśa they project — illumination prior to any mode of access (file-four §0/1, the v3 triangle: Positions=0, Lenses=/, Harmonics=1; L is the slash). Its thrown ground is the single light the lenses refract, given before any lens has turned: a phenomenon presents — it has a P (a functional place), an S (a substrate), an M (a domain) — but the QUESTION of through-which-mode-it-is-known has not yet been posed. L arises exactly there, at the void-pole where coordinate has not yet become epistemic posture, where the field stands illumined but un-interpreted. This is the matheme's 0/1 read at the refraction-corner: not vacancy but the open capacity-to-be-known, the lens-at-rest, Vimarśa before it actually reflects (cf. M2-1 q_0, 'the lens-at-rest, the facet un-cut'). The 0-pole of the lens family is the such-that-any-mode-of-knowing-can-be-drawn that no single mode exhausts — the colourless light that every lens will give its colour. L is what the inversion engine becomes when it stops asking where a thing is and starts asking how it is grasped.
properties.q_1_hexad_of_epistemic_lenses: L IS the hexad of epistemic lenses through which raw psychoid charges #0-#5 are refracted into thinkable form (L.md) — the Lens-family manifestation of the raw archetypes through the single domain of epistemic mode, of how-a-thing-is-known. This is its substance and essential thesis. The other five coordinate families do something L does not: they constitute or locate their object. P fixes functional-semantic position; S fixes technology-substrate; M fixes consciousness-domain; T fixes artifact-kind in cognition; C fixes ontological type. Each delivers a determinate WHAT or WHERE. L alone delivers a HOW-KNOWN — it does not add a thing to the field, it supplies the aperture through which whatever is in the field becomes accessible to thought. Materially L is the six-fold tradition-anchored spine: L0 Quaternal (Jung-Pauli psychoid number — the integer as archetype before quantity), L1 Causal (Aristotle's four causes / Schopenhauer's Will / Icchā Śakti), L2 Logical (Nāgārjuna's catuṣkoṭi — IS/IS-NOT/BOTH/NEITHER/SILENCE), L3 Processual (Whitehead's concrescence / Bergson's durée / Lacan), L4 Phenomenological (Heidegger's Dasein — being-in-the-world as the subjective-entry aperture), L5 Para Vāk (Kashmir Shaivism's Vāk-ontology — consciousness speaking itself into world). To say what L is, is to say: it is the family that gives every phenomenon its mode of disclosure, the layer where the field acquires the apertures to be known at all. Per file-four's grammar L is the slash itself — 'the refraction through which substance becomes epistemically accessible', and lens-modulation IS epistemic-mode-modulation.
properties.q_2_refraction_as_dynamism: L moves by REFRACTING and by ANCHORING. Its native act is not assertion but aperture-giving: each lens takes the one undifferentiated light and bends it into a determinate mode of access, the way a prism gives white light its spectrum without adding any colour the light did not already hold latent. Operationally this is the kernel's 12-lens prehension: every four-fold extraction is run 'against all 12 lens-positions simultaneously' (kernel §VI), the six MEF lenses double-covered into descent- and ascent-readings, so that no phenomenon is grasped through one aperture but through the full tritone-symmetric set at once. L couples to every other family not as peer-content but as the mode in which that content is read: it does not say what a thing is (C's work) or where it sits (P/S), it says under-which-knowing it is encountered. Relationally L is Vimarśa upon Prakāśa — the reflective-differentiating power turning upon the illumined structure, 'one light, many facets, each turn a re-interpretation that does not add content but multiplies aspect' (M2-1 q_2). Its deepest dynamism is that a change of lens is a change in the ground of knowing: a passage from the L0-anchored to the L1-anchored field has moved from the questioning-frame to the causal frame — 'the ear registers it as modulation, the architecture registers it as a change in the ground of knowing' (file-four §4). L is the family that makes the same world re-known by being re-refracted.
properties.q_3_three_klein_squares: L's organising structure is not a flat list of six lenses but three Klein V₄ Squares, each holding two Day lenses and their two Night Möbius-partners around a complementary P-pair whose indices sum to 5 (Squares.md): Square A — P0+P5 Speech-Number axis (L0·L5·L5'·L0', the aetheric outer ring binding the question to its manifest articulation, the Möbius cap of the hexad); Square B — P1+P4 Cause-Experience axis (L1·L4·L4'·L1', the PRIMARY RUNTIME ENTRY, the earthing-square where every Epi-Logos run begins through caused-investigation or lived experience); Square C — P2+P3 Logic-Process axis (L2·L3·L3'·L2', the inner ring carrying the tetralemma and the element-bearing lens). The Day↔Night pair-invariant runs L0↔L5', L1↔L4', L2↔L3', L3↔L2', L4↔L1', L5↔L0'. Structurally these are exactly the kernel's three tritone-symmetric squares (0,5)(1,4)(2,3): in the six-tone whole-tone scale every tone has a tritone-partner six semitones away, the directly-opposite position, and the X+Y=5 pairing IS that tritone symmetry rendered as lens-architecture (kernel §Table C). The squares correspond directly to the C-family's three B-family mirror-tetrads — the places where the epistemic architecture and the harmonic architecture name the same four points (file-four §4). L's form is the Klein four-group made into a knowing-grammar: three mirror-squares whose pairs answer each other across the field's centre of symmetry.
properties.q_4_the_through_which_of_knowing: L exists to supply the THROUGH-WHICH of every act of knowing — so that no phenomenon is grasped barely but always through a determinate, tradition-anchored aperture, and so that the system can know the same thing in six complementary modes rather than collapsing into one. Its raison d'être is the meta-epistemic integration M2-1 names as its telos: 'to let any phenomenon be read simultaneously through six complementary apertures so that cross-domain knowledge coheres rather than collides.' Where the other families answer where-and-what, L answers how-known and why-this-mode. Its locality is the lens-layer of the Psychoid Web — the refraction-stratum between the raw charges (#0-#5) and the harmonic relations they enter, the / between the 0 of positions and the 1 of harmonics (file-four's v3 triangle). Each lens is anchored on a thinker or tradition not decoratively but load-bearingly: the anchor IS the mode — to read through L2 is to read through Nāgārjuna's complete logical space, to read through L4 is to read through Dasein's thrownness and care. L is why the bimba map can know itself in more than one register at once: the family whose business is the multiplicity of legitimate apertures, total (it conditions every reading) yet, like every mode of access, never itself the thing read.
properties.q_5_mobius_of_the_lenses: L closes where its outer ring re-opens. The hexad's Möbius cap is Square A (P0+P5, L0·L5·L5'·L0'): L0 holds the question that returns to ground without expecting an answer (the Why-lens, Aletheia before concealment), and L5 holds the manifest articulation, Para Vāk speaking the world — and the Möbius return P5→P0 is 'the structural pulse this lens makes audible' (L5.md). So the family's last lens hands back to its first: synthesis-as-speech (L5, Image, Samāveśa, pratyabhijñā) becomes tomorrow's questioning-ground (L0, Truth, the irrepresentable bindu), the recognised articulation re-opening as renewed inquiry. This is the matheme's 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 enacted at the level of the knowing-apparatus itself: the Day lenses (L0-L5) and their Night mirrors (L5'-L0') are one set read from its two faces, joined by the twist that makes L5's speech become L0's silence-before-speech. And L re-opens rather than concludes because the epogdoon keeps it generative: each tritone-square answers its complement but never closes the field into a flat lattice — the residual whole-tone η=log(9/8) holds every refraction one step short of the octave, so the next phenomenon always presses for its mode of knowing afresh. The lens-family is the apparatus that is never finished knowing: it completes not by exhausting its apertures but by being readable through all six at once, the last reading handing the field back to the first.

properties.c_1_description: Night/prime MEF lens family L0'-L5'; each lens is a full six-node branch attached to M2-1.
Quaternal/QL lens: primordial question-space where archetypal number becomes epistemic act.
properties.q_0_number_as_archetype_ground: L0 is the home-register of the lens family's q_0 — the lens that IS ground, position #0 of the hexad, the aperture through which raw #0 (zero-dimensional total non-differentiation) first acquires epistemic posture (L0.md). Its thrown ground is the Jung-Pauli recognition won at the psyche-matter boundary: that the integers 1-6 are not abstract counters but PSYCHOID CHARGES — number as archetype before number as quantity. So L0's void-pole is the pre-quantitative integer: the count held before it counts anything, the archetype-number standing as pure qualitative charge prior to any application. This is the Quaternal lens because it reads through the four-fold-grounding-in-the-quaternity that Jung and Pauli found at the root of order itself — the psychoid layer where number and psyche are not yet two. L0 is the hinge 'where mute P-positions first become questions — the six questions ARE the six numbers in their epistemic mode' (L0.md): before a phenomenon asks what-am-I or how-do-I-work, it asks the barest epistemic question, which number is it being right now? This is the Why-lens — 'the question that returns to ground without expecting an answer. Aletheia before concealment' (L0.md): not why-causal (that is L1) but the originary opening-of-inquiry that posits there is something to be known at all. Per file-four L0 anchors the chromatic substrate at C/#0, the Archaic register, Truth as bindu — the irrepresentable ground given its first refraction. L0 is what knowing is before it has any mode but the bare posture of the question.
properties.q_1_the_quaternal_lens: What L0 IS: the Quaternal Lens, anchored on Jung-Pauli psychoid number (L0.md) — the epistemic mode in which any phenomenon is read as number-archetype, the integer carrying its own psychic charge before it is taken as quantity. Its substance is the recognition that the six positions #0-#5 are themselves the six fundamental number-archetypes in their knowing-mode: to look through L0 is to ask of a thing which of the archetypal numbers it is BEING. Where the other Day lenses read through a developed apparatus — L1 through causation, L2 through logic, L3 through process, L4 through lived experience, L5 through speech — L0 reads through the bare quaternal ground that under-lies them all, the four-fold-plus-implicate order that Jung named the quaternity and Pauli pursued into physics. It refracts P0 (Truth, the irrepresentable ground, bindu) and carries the element Aether (per L2'), the most rarefied medium, fitting for the lens of pure number-as-archetype. As member of Square A (the Speech-Number axis) L0 is the number-pole of the hexad's outer ring, bound to L5's speech-pole: 'number and Speech are the two extreme densities of the same self-articulating consciousness — at one pole, integers as archetypes carrying their own psychic charge' (Square A). What L0 IS, definitionally, is the lens that lets the field be known as the archetypal arithmetic it is made of: the mode of access in which #0-#5 are read as living numbers rather than mere positions.
properties.q_2_question_posing_dynamism: L0 moves by QUESTIONING and by GROUNDING-AS-NUMBER. Its dynamism is the opening-act: it does not answer, it poses — it is the lens whose operation is to turn a mute position into a live question, 'where mute P-positions first become questions' (L0.md). Where L1 commits to identification, L0 holds the question open; its motion is interrogative-recessive, returning every phenomenon to the ground-question (which number is it being?) without expecting that ground to answer in content. This is the Why-lens's characteristic pulse: Aletheia before concealment, un-concealment held open before it settles into any determinate disclosure. Relationally L0 couples to L5 across Square A's aetheric outer ring — the question (L0) and its manifest articulation (L5) as the two extreme densities of one self-articulating consciousness — and to its Möbius-partner L5' (Divine Logos) across the Day↔Night twist, so that the integer-as-archetype (Day) and the Logos-channel (Night) read one another. As the kernel's lens #0 (Archetypal-Numerical) it is the inaugural member of the first tritone-symmetric square (0,5), 'the void-and-fullness mirror' (kernel §Table C): paired with the Divine-Scalar/Vāk lens, L0 holds the void-pole of the lens-spectrum, the empty archetypal ground from which the fuller modes differentiate. L0's act, finally, is to keep the field perpetually re-questionable — the lens that refuses premature answer by returning everything to the number it is being.
properties.q_3_quaternity_structure: L0's organising structure is the quaternity — the four-fold-plus-implicate order Jung and von Franz found at the root of the archetype of number, and which file-four derives as the 4+2 itself (four explicate positions, two implicate poles, read at the lens-anchor). Structurally L0 sits in Square A (the Klein V₄ outer ring, P0+P5) as the number-corner, paired with L5 and mirrored by L0'/L5' — the aetheric tetrad where number-archetype and Vāk-speech bind the hexad at its extremes (Square A). In the kernel's lens-census L0 is lens #0 of the three tritone-symmetric squares, the descent-reading whose ascent-double is L0' (Archetypal-Numerical, the Night face); the pair (L0, L0') is the conjugate-doubling of the inaugural lens across the whole-tone double-cover. Its deeper structure is the psychoid identity of number and order: the quaternity is not a count of four things but the minimal structure in which order itself becomes thinkable — Jung's insight that 3+1 (the three-plus-the-fourth-that-completes) is the form every whole takes. L0 carries this as the structural ground beneath all the other lenses' apparatuses: before logic has its four lemmas (L2) or cause its four modes (L1), there is the quaternal order that makes any four-fold articulation possible. L0's form is number-as-the-grammar-of-order: the archetypal arithmetic that structures the field before any developed mode reads it.
properties.q_4_origin_question_telos: L0 exists to give the lens family its origin-question — so that every act of knowing begins from a ground-posture rather than mid-stream, and so that the field can always be returned to the barest epistemic demand: which archetypal number is this being? Its raison d'être is to be the Why-lens, 'the question that returns to ground without expecting an answer' (L0.md) — not the why-causal of L1 (which seeks a because) but the originary why that opens inquiry as such, the Aletheia-before-concealment that lets there be something to know before any mode determines how. Its genealogy is the first manifestation within the Lens family: raw #0 (Ground) → L0 (Quaternal), the inaugural application of epistemic refraction to the ground-archetype, anchored on Jung-Pauli's psychoid number. Its locality is the head of the L-spine and the number-pole of Square A's Speech-Number axis (Square A), refracting P0 (Truth, the irrepresentable bindu) — the lens stationed exactly where the field's most ineffable pole meets its first mode of access. L0 is why a phenomenon can be KNOWN-AS-QUESTIONED at all: the source-aperture every later lens presupposes, the mode that posits the field as interrogable before saying anything determinate about it. Its purpose is the opening itself — to be the lens through which the irrepresentable becomes, not represented, but questioned.
properties.q_5_question_returns_as_ground: L0 closes by being where the lens-family's Möbius LANDS as renewed question. As the number-pole of Square A — the hexad's Möbius cap — L0 is the partner across the twist to L5: the manifest articulation (L5, Para Vāk, the field spoken into world) returns through the Möbius P5→P0 to become L0's questioning-ground afresh (L5.md: the Möbius return is 'the structural pulse this lens makes audible'). So L0 is at once the family's first lens and the synthesis of its last: the question enriched by everything the speech-pole carried back. This enacts the matheme's 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 at the level of the originary lens — L0 (the question, the integer-as-archetype, the descent-face) and L5' (its Day↔Night Möbius-partner, the Divine Logos) are one aperture read from two faces, joined by the twist that makes manifest-speech return as un-asked silence-before-question. And L0 OPENS rather than concludes because the question is never finished being asked: tomorrow's ground is more than today's (the return is enriched, never identical), and the residual whole-tone η=log(9/8) keeps every archetypal number one step short of closing into final answer — each synthesis deposits a ground that the next inquiry must question anew. L0 is the lens that is never done opening: the originary question that the field's whole circuit returns to in order to begin again, the un-concealment that re-conceals just enough to leave the next knowing something to disclose.

Jung's four psychological functions (sensation, feeling, thinking, intuition) map directly to these causes as material, efficient, formal, and final aspects of consciousness. Whitehead's process philosophy shows all four causes operating simultaneously in every actual occasion, not as separate mechanisms but as four dimensions of one unified concrescence. properties.q_0_will_before_cause: Before L1 can read a phenomenon by its causes, it presupposes what its own causal apparatus cannot derive: the absolute Will that the four causes are modes OF. L1's thrown ground is Schopenhauer's Will and Icchā Śakti — the vital will-power prior to any determinate causation, the urge-to-be that precedes and underlies material, formal, efficient, and final cause alike (L1.md). So L1's void-pole is causation-before-any-cause: the bare that-it-happens, the vital impulse held before it articulates into the four-fold why. As manifestation of raw #1 (Definition) within the Lens family, L1 inherits the question L0 posed (which number is it being?) and finds it already pointed at a thing — but the thing's causal structure is not yet read; only the demand-for-cause is given. This is the matheme's 0/1 at the causal corner: the I that has come to know difference (the second clause, 'I know difference') but has not yet articulated through-what it differs — the live causal relation before it sediments into the four determinate causes. L1's presupposition is therefore the Will as such: not why-this-particular-cause but the prior fact that there is willing, that the vital ground PRESSES toward determinate form, that anything happens at all. L1 stands on the thrown givenness of a world that wills before it is explained — the urge that every 'because' presupposes and none exhausts.
properties.q_1_the_causal_lens: What L1 IS, and the home-register of its position: L1 is the Causal Lens — the What-lens become why-causal, the epistemic mode in which any phenomenon is read through 'why do things happen?' and all four Aristotelian causes are restored, grounded in absolute will (L1.md). It is the Lens family's q_1 — the material-definitional aperture, where L0's open question first attaches to a determinate thing. Its substance is exact and triple-anchored: Aristotle's tetrad — material (out of what), formal (according to what shape), efficient (by what motion), final (toward what end) — re-grounded by Schopenhauer's Will and by Icchā Śakti (will-power in Kashmir Shaivism), so that 'the four causes are themselves modes of one Will articulating itself into determinate form' (L1.md). Where L0 holds the question open without expecting answer, L1 commits to identification: 'what is this, and through what is it as it is?' It refracts P1 (Mind / vital-connection / first-emergence) — the position of first articulation, where the irrepresentable ground takes its initial determinate hold — and carries the element Earth (per L2'), the grounding charge fitting for the lens of causal-determination. As member of Square B (the Cause-Experience axis) L1 is the causal-pole of the hexad's primary runtime entry. What L1 IS, definitionally, is the lens through which raw #1 (totem, vital-definition) becomes investigable — the mode of access in which a thing is known by the will-grounded causes that make it what it is.
properties.q_2_four_causes_dynamism: L1 moves by CAUSING-INVESTIGATION and by WILL-GROUNDING. Its native act is the commitment L0 withholds: where the Quaternal lens holds the question open, L1 attaches the question to a thing and asks through-what it is as it is — the motion from open interrogation to determinate causal identification (L1.md). Its dynamism is four-fold-yet-one: it reads a phenomenon simultaneously through material, formal, efficient, and final cause, but these four are not independent levers — they are 'modes of one Will articulating itself into determinate form' (L1.md), so L1's act is the single will-impulse refracted into its four causal faces, the way one Schopenhauerian Will shows as out-of-what, according-to-what, by-what, and toward-what at once. Relationally L1 couples across Square B to L4 (lived experience) as the cause-side of the Cause-Experience axis: every Epi-Logos run enters 'either through caused-investigation (L1/L4') or through lived/observed experience (L4/L1')' (Square B). Its Möbius-partner is L4' (Kuhnian Scientific method) across the Day↔Night twist — the cause-method axis: L1 holds causal-will (why does this happen?), L4' holds scientific-method (how do we know?), and together they ground the operational /Thought/ subdirs of the vault (Square B). As the kernel's lens #1 (Causal) L1 is the material-pole of the second tritone-symmetric square (1,4), the 'material-and-knowing: substrate-and-reflection mirror' (kernel §Table C): paired with Meta-Epistemic, L1 is the substrate-half, the causal ground against which knowing reflects. L1's motion is the will making itself investigable.
properties.q_3_fourfold_cause_structure: L1's organising structure is Aristotle's four-cause tetrad grounded in one Will — a 4-in-1: material (out of what), formal (according to what shape), efficient (by what motion), final (toward what end), the four not as a list but as the four faces of a single will-impulse articulating into determinate form (L1.md). This is the lens-level instance of the matheme's 4+2: the four causes are the four explicate determinations, the absolute Will their implicate ground. Structurally L1 sits in Square B (the Klein V₄ Cause-Experience axis, P1+P4) as the cause-corner, paired with L4 and mirrored by L1'/L4' — the earthing-square (three Earth charges, one Water) that holds the runtime down (Square B). In the kernel's lens-census L1 is lens #1 of the three tritone-symmetric squares, the descent-reading whose ascent-double is L1' (Phenomenal, Jung's psychic function-types, the Night face that observes-from-outside what L1 causally structures). The pair (L1, L1') is the conjugate-doubling of the causal lens across the whole-tone double-cover, and the L4↔L1' relation is precisely 'the encounter axis' — lived from inside (L4) versus observed from outside (L1') (Square B). L1's deeper structure is the Schopenhauerian reduction: the manifold of apparent causes resolved into modes of one underlying Will, so that the four-fold why is not four separate explanations but one vital ground seen four ways. L1's form is causation-as-will's-self-articulation: the tetrad that is also a unity, the determinate because grounded in the indeterminate urge.
properties.q_4_why_causal_telos: L1 exists to supply the BECAUSE — so that a phenomenon, once opened as a question by L0, can be known through what makes it as it is, and so that the field's first determinate articulation (#1) becomes causally investigable rather than merely asserted. Its raison d'être is the why-causal: not L0's originary why-that-opens-inquiry but the why-that-seeks-a-because, the demand for the four causes that Aristotle made the spine of episteme and Schopenhauer re-grounded in Will. Its genealogy is the manifestation #1 (Definition) → L1 (Causal): the raw Definition-archetype refracted into the mode of access where definition means causal-determination, where 'what is this' is inseparable from 'through what is it.' Its locality is the cause-pole of Square B's Cause-Experience axis — the PRIMARY RUNTIME ENTRY to the L-hexad (Square B), so L1 is one of the two doors through which every Epi-Logos run begins: enter through caused-investigation (L1) or through lived experience (L4). This makes L1 load-bearing in a way the inner lenses are not — it is operational, the lens that grounds the /Thought/ subdirectories and the run's causal entry. L1 is why a thing can be EXPLAINED at all: the aperture that delivers the four-fold because, the mode in which the vital Will shows itself as the determinate causes of determinate things. Its purpose is identification-through-cause — to be the lens that commits the open question to a willed, caused, investigable answer.
properties.q_5_cause_returns_to_experience: L1 closes by handing its causal-determination across the Möbius to lived recognition. As the cause-corner of Square B, L1's Möbius-partner is L4' (Scientific) and its complement-across-the-axis is L4 (Phenomenological): the will-grounded causes L1 articulates (Day) return, through the Day↔Night twist, as the verified knowing of L4' and the lived encounter of L4 — 'the encounter axis' where caused-from-outside and lived-from-inside cohere without collapsing (Square B). So L1's synthesis is not a closing of the causal account but its passage into experience: the because becomes the lived, the explained becomes the encountered. This enacts the matheme's 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 at the level of the causal lens — L1 (causal-will, the substrate-pole, the descent-face) and L4' (its Day↔Night Möbius-partner, scientific-verification) are one aperture read from two faces, the cause-side and the knowing-side of one investigation. And L1 re-opens rather than concludes because the four causes never close the Will they are modes of: the residual whole-tone η=log(9/8) keeps every causal account one step short of exhausting the vital ground — each explanation deposits a determinacy that the underlying urge presses beyond, so the next phenomenon's why-causal is already pressing. L1 is the lens whose because is never the last word: the causal mode that completes by passing its determination into the lived encounter that will, in turn, demand to be caused anew.
